subject: DPA + Transfer Addendum: MSA & Order Form alignment
messages:
From: Susan Miller <susan.miller@clearhealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legalops@clearhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 16:12:00 +01:00
Subject: ClearHealth DPA redlines + transfer addendum questions

Hi David,

Attached are ClearHealth's initial redlines to the Redwood DPA and an Order Form with hosting selections marked. Two quick asks so we can keep procurement moving: 

1) Can Redwood confirm whether the Order Form can be constrained to Dedicated (reserved) capacity in the EU only? Our security team requires dedicated tenancy for PHI-like workloads.
2) On SCCs — we noted Redwood's parenthetical references to 'Redwood Inference' and a couple of subprocessor entries that we don't recognize. Can you provide a current subprocessor roster and confirm who signs the SCCs on your side?

We included a provisional transfer addendum draft (see attachment) that clarifies routing and KMS responsibilities. If the technical routing or KMS options are locked behind an enterprise add-on, please flag that so we can budget accordingly.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Regards,
Susan Miller
Head of Legal Operations
ClearHealth

Attachments: ClearHealth_DPA-redline_20250804.docx, OrderForm_v2.pdf

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Miller <susan.miller@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearHealth DPA redlines + transfer addendum questions

Susan — thanks for the redlines and the Order Form. Looping in Laura (privacy counsel) and Ben (contracts) to get legal + ops alignment. High level response and asks from our side: 

- Dedicated-only EU tenancy: we can commit to Dedicated capacity pinned to EU regions, but need to confirm the instance sizing and whether you want Dedicated pools at an SLA tier (there's a slight pricing delta). Ben, can you flag the pricing trigger for dedicated EU-only?
- SCCs: Redwood signs SCCs via the company exec team; we will provide the most recent subprocessor roster (including our managed infra partners). Laura — can you prepare the roster and indicate any outstanding subprocessor caveats?
- KMS & encryption: we support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated / Private deploys, and for Hosted we offer an HSM-backed key option as an enterprise add-on. If ClearHealth needs BYOK for the Order Form, we should document it in the addendum as an operational dependency.

Next steps proposed: 
1) Laura to provide subprocessor roster + call out any DPA language changes (by EOD tomorrow).
2) Ben to prepare a brief redline summary and pricing note for dedicated-eu constraint (by EOD tomorrow).
3) I'll propose slots for a 30m call with ClearHealth to walk the transfer addendum.

If that works I'll send a consolidated response and meeting invite.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Customer Engineering, Redwood Inference

> On Mon, Aug 4, 2025 at 16:12 +01:00, Susan Miller wrote:
> > Attached are ClearHealth's initial redlines to the Redwood DPA and an Order Form with hosting selections marked...

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearHealth DPA redlines + transfer addendum questions

Quick notes from contracts ops after an initial pass of the attachment: 

- Pricing trigger: Dedicated EU-only will push them into our Dedicated capacity SKU; that requires a minimum 6-month commit in the Order Form. If they want flexible burst to Hosted we can include a fallback clause but it will need approval.
- SCCs signing: Redwood uses the Exec Legal sig block; however ClearHealth's draft had custom liability slices in clause 8 — suggest we counter with a limited carve that keeps indemnity exposure capped.
- Subprocessors: we should provide a living roster link (not embedded in DPA) and add a 30-day notice for new subprocessors. ClearHealth asked about unknown entries — likely our managed storage partner and a telemetry aggregator; I'll annotate the roster.

Action: I'll produce a redline summary (tracked changes) and two alternative Order Form language snippets (A: dedicated-only commitment, B: dedicated with hosted fallback) for David to review. Expect that by tomorrow morning.

– Ben
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Miller <susan.miller@clearhealth.com>, Legal Ops <legalops@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearHealth DPA redlines + transfer addendum questions — consolidation and next steps

Susan / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attaching our consolidated package (summary + two Order Form options) and a proposed short transfer addendum that captures: EU-only Dedicated routing, BYOK KMS option for Dedicated, SCCs execution path, and a subprocessor roster link with a 30-day notice clause.

Plan: 
1) We propose option A (Dedicated-only, 6-month commit) as the default to meet your security ask. If procurement needs flexibility we can use option B and record a controlled fallback to Hosted for non-PHI traffic.
2) Laura will share the subprocessor roster and highlight the managed infra partners (today EOD EU time).
3) If you agree in principle, we can start DocuSign execution for the DPA + Order Form and then finalize the transfer addendum as an exhibit.

Proposed meeting: Wed 6 Aug, 10:00–10:30 CET (I'll send a calendar invite). Please confirm availability or suggest alternatives.

Links/attachments: ClearHealth_DPA-redline_20250804.docx (their markup), Redwood_DPA-summary_20250805.pdf, OrderForm_optionA.pdf, OrderForm_optionB.pdf, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cClearHealth-DPA

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

David Kim
Head of Customer Engineering
Redwood Inference
